insight: A French startup based in Metz, backed by Crédit Agricole's Le Village accelerator and SKEMA Entrepreneurs.
name: Wiseone
tagline: AI search and reading copilot that lives in your browser.
description: A browser extension that overlays an AI assistant on any web page: summarize long articles, ask questions about what you're reading, and use Focus to unpack complex terms in place. Its Cross-check feature pulls independent sources on a claim, and Suggestions surfaces related news, academic papers, and videos — so research happens without leaving the tab.

modelSupport.notes: Routes across commercial LLMs (e.g. GPT-4, Mistral Large).

edge: Built for reading on the open web — its Cross-check and Focus tools verify claims and explain jargon in-place, not just summarize.
pros: Surfaces related papers, news, and videos
Works on any website you visit
